pages.text: Empty space looks empty only if you are not accelerating. Accelerate at a, and the vacuum glows at $(thing)T = ħa/(2πck)$() - one kelvin needs 2.5×10²⁰ m/s².

The $(item)Unruh Accelerator$() is a storage ring: electrons of Lorentz factor γ bent by a field B feel a = γ²c²/r, with r = γmc/eB. Gently, it calibrates an $(item)Unruh Thermometer$() (1-10 K). Hard - above 5000 K - its bath turns superfluid helium into Hawking radiation. But the beam radiates as γ³B, and the cavities replace only 500 kW.
